about.title: About
about.tagline: Who builds it, and what for.
about.author: PokerStudio Replayer is conceived and built by Felipe Carvalho Lana, an IT professional with more than 23 years in the field. A computing technician, with a BSc in Computer Science and an MBA in Information Technology Management from FGV, Felipe has spent over two decades designing, building and leading systems — from the line of code to the architecture and the running of technology itself.
about.origin: The tool comes out of a real gap in the poker market and out of Felipe’s own restlessness as a player: there was no replayer that was intuitive, good-looking, easy to use and genuinely improving. That is the test every screen here has to pass — what helps you study stays; what gets in the way goes.
about.method: Continuous improvement is not a line in a footer here, it is the method: the replayer is revisited against real use, and what players ask for goes into the queue.
about.vision: The replayer is only the kick-off. PokerStudio means to be the reference in tools that help poker players study, play and perform better at the tables.

welcome.title: Welcome to PokerStudio Replayer
welcome.body: One minute and you will know where everything is: bringing hands in, opening a review, making the table yours, and telling us what is missing.

import.title: 1. Bring your hands in
import.body: Drag a .txt hand history here, or click to choose one. One file at a time — the way you play one tournament at a time.

sessions.title: 2. Open a review
sessions.body: Every file you import becomes a row here. Double-click the row to open it, or use the play button. The replayer comes back to the exact hand you stopped on.

settings.title: 3. Make it yours
settings.body: Date format, where the hero sits, how close the seats are, leak tags and your screen names per room — all under Settings.

skins.title: 4. Dress the table
skins.body: Skins is where the felt, the deck, the chips and the name plates change, card by card if you like. Save as many as you need; they live on your account.

feedback.title: 5. Talk to us
feedback.body: Your account menu holds Suggestions and improvements, and About. Whatever you write there goes straight into our queue.

replayWelcome.title: The table, up close
replayWelcome.body: One step per control: what every button, icon and bar on this screen does.

replayHands.title: Your hands
replayHands.body: The left column lists every hand in the review, with position and result. Click one to jump straight to it. Above it are the filters, the focus player and the report button.

replayTable.title: The table
replayTable.body: This is where the hand plays out. Click a name plate to focus that player; the chair beside the name moves where the hero sits; the magnifier opens an external lookup.

replayQuick.title: Quick controls
replayQuick.body: Skin, deck colours, how the hero cards are laid out, zoom for table, cards and chips, how close the seats sit and the board spacing — without leaving the hand.

replayFullscreen.title: Full screen
replayFullscreen.body: Everything but the table gets out of the way. Good for looking at one hand properly, and for recording.

replayNotes.title: Notes
replayNotes.body: Opens the review panel for this hand: your notes, leak tags and what goes into the report.

replayLog.title: What happened
replayLog.body: The hand told action by action. Click a line to jump to that moment.

replayStreets.title: Jump to a street
replayStreets.body: Preflop, the hero’s first action, flop, turn and river. Every one has a keyboard shortcut — press ? for the list.

replayTransport.title: Drive the replay
replayTransport.body: First, previous, play/pause, next and last. Beside them: the frame counter, the result-bar mode and the speed.

replayTimeline.title: The hand bar
replayTimeline.body: One square per hand in the review, coloured by result. Click to go straight there, and use it to spot the big hands at a glance.

replay.4: Exact resume: a review reopens on the hand and the point where you stopped.

visual.1: Deck skins in four colours and in two, black and white.
visual.2: Skin editor: felt, table, chips, name plates and card by card.
visual.3: A light 3D table, with a 2D alternative that works without WebGL.

analysis.1: Notes, leak tags and comments per hand, with a PDF report.

languages.0: Interface in Portuguese, English, Spanish, German, Russian, Mandarin, Japanese and Korean.

next.0: More rooms: GGPoker, 888poker, iPoker, WPN, CoinPoker and Ignition (Bodog).

share.title: Share review
share.tooltip: Create a link and a password for a coach or friend to read this session
share.subtitle: A link and a password for whoever you ask to read {{review}}.
share.passwordRule: Eight characters, with upper case, lower case and a digit, and no digits in a run.
share.expiryNote: Expires on {{when}}. The most allowed is {{max}} hours.
share.passwordOnce: The password is shown now and not again. It is not in the link, so send both and keep the password if you may need it.
share.readOnlyNote: Whoever opens the link sees this session alone, replays the hands and writes what they think of each one. Nothing else on your account is reachable.
share.feedbackEmpty: Nothing has been written in this review yet.

coach.title: Read a session
coach.lead: You were sent a link. Type the password that came with it.
coach.privacyNote: You see this session and nothing else. No other part of the account that shared it is reachable through this link.
coach.badLink: This link is not valid. Ask for another from whoever shared the session.
coach.noHistory: This session was saved without the text of the hands, so they cannot be replayed here. Whoever shared it can turn on keeping the histories and send a new link.
coach.loadFailed: The hands could not be loaded right now. Try again in a moment.
coach.finished: Review finished and sent to whoever shared the session.
coach.finishNote: Finishing sends the review to whoever shared the session, and it cannot be changed afterwards.
